title: Markeith Loyd – Lt. Debra Clayton Shooting and Arrest Video (January 2017)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Florida Sunshine Law, I hereby request the following records:

Records concerning the January 9, 2017 shooting death of Orlando Police Lt. Debra Clayton at the Walmart on W. Princeton Street in Orlando, and the arrest of Markeith Loyd on or about January 17, 2017. Specifically:

1. All body-worn camera and in-car camera video from officers who responded to the Walmart shooting on January 9, 2017.
2. Walmart surveillance video of the incident collected as evidence.
3. 911 calls, radio/dispatch audio and CAD logs for the January 9, 2017 incident.
4. All body-worn, in-car and aerial video of Markeith Loyd's arrest on or about January 17, 2017.
5. Video recordings of any police interviews with Markeith Loyd.
6. The incident/offense reports for both events.

Markeith Loyd was convicted in November 2021 and sentenced on March 3, 2022, and the Florida Supreme Court affirmed his conviction and sentence in November 2023.

I understand that any portion of a recording depicting the killing of a law enforcement officer is confidential under s. 406.136, Florida Statutes. Please redact only those portions and release the remainder of each recording, including the response, aftermath, manhunt and arrest.

Please provide video and audio in their original digital format, with audio intact, via download link or file-sharing service. If any portion is withheld or redacted, please cite the specific exemption for each item. If this request is large, please release records on a rolling basis, starting with items 4, 5 and 1.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Luka Thriller
